steps.name: Enforce language policies
steps.run:
# Block new Python files (Python fully banned 2026-01-03 — SaltStack carveout removed)
NEW_PY=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD~1 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.py$' || true)
if [ -n "$NEW_PY" ]; then
  echo "❌ New Python files detected. Use Rust or AffineScript instead."
  echo "$NEW_PY"
  exit 1
fi

# Block new Ruby files
NEW_RB=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD~1 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.rb$' || true)
if [ -n "$NEW_RB" ]; then
  echo "❌ New Ruby files detected. Use Rust, Ada/SPARK, or Crystal instead."
  echo "$NEW_RB"
  exit 1
fi

# Block new Perl files
NEW_PL=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD~1 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(pl|pm)$' || true)
if [ -n "$NEW_PL" ]; then
  echo "❌ New Perl files detected. Use Rust instead."
  echo "$NEW_PL"
  exit 1
fi

# Block new Java/Kotlin (except in LSP projects)
if [[ ! "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" =~ "language-server" ]]; then
  NEW_JAVA=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD~1 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(java|kt)$' || true)
  if [ -n "$NEW_JAVA" ]; then
    echo "❌ New Java/Kotlin files detected. Use Rust instead."
    echo "$NEW_JAVA"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# Block new TypeScript files (banned 2026-04-30, replacement: AffineScript).
# Carve-outs (parallel to hypatia cicd_rules/typescript_detected path_allow_prefixes):
#   *.d.ts                          declaration files (headers, not impl)
#   */bindings/{deno,ts,typescript}/  interop targets (consumers of our work)
#   2-protocols/avow/telegram-bot/avow-telegram-bot/  Telegraf PERMANENT exemption
#   *.config.ts / vite.config.ts / vitest.config.ts / tsup.config.ts  tooling
#   affinescript-deno-test/ + affinescript-cli/  bootstrap shims
#   rescript/ + servers/ + repos-monorepo/ + linguist/  upstream forks
#   hyperpolymath-archive/  archived repos
#   **/deps/                        Mix-style vendored package-manager deps
#   **/vscode/                      VSCode extension entry points (blocked on AS bindings)
NEW_TS=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD~1 2>/dev/null \
  | grep -E '\.tsx?$' \
  | grep -vE '\.d\.ts$' \
  | grep -vE '/bindings/(deno|typescript|ts)/' \
  | grep -vE '^2-protocols/avow/telegram-bot/avow-telegram-bot/' \
  | grep -vE '(^|/)(vite|vitest|tsup)\.config\.ts$' \
  | grep -vE '\.config\.ts$' \
  | grep -vE '^(affinescript-deno-test|affinescript-cli)/' \
  | grep -vE '^(rescript|servers|repos-monorepo|linguist|hyperpolymath-archive)/' \
  | grep -vE '/deps/' \
  | grep -vE '/vscode/' \
  || true)
if [ -n "$NEW_TS" ]; then
  echo "❌ New TypeScript files detected (banned 2026-04-30). Use AffineScript instead."
  echo "$NEW_TS"
  echo ""
  echo "If this file genuinely belongs to a carve-out class, add it via"
  echo "the hypatia rule's path_allow_prefixes — see standards/.claude/CLAUDE.md"
  echo "§TypeScript Exemptions (Approved)."
  exit 1
fi

# Block new ReScript files (banned 2026-05-25, replacement: AffineScript).
# Carve-outs (parallel to hypatia cicd_rules/rescript_detected +
# rescript_interface_detected path_allow_prefixes — 8 classes):
#   bsconfig.json + *.config.res    tooling
#   rescript/ + servers/ + repos-monorepo/ + linguist/  upstream forks
#   hyperpolymath-archive/  archived repos
#   **/deps/ + **/node_modules/  vendored package-manager deps
#   **/vscode/  VSCode extension entry points (blocked on AS bindings)
#   **/lib/js/ + **/lib/es6/ + **/lib/bs/  bsc compilation output
#   affinescript-deno-test/ + affinescript-cli/  bootstrap shims
#   2-protocols/avow/telegram-bot/avow-telegram-bot/  Telegraf carve-out
NEW_RS=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD~1 2>/dev/null \
  | grep -E '\.resi?$' \
  | grep -vE '(^|/)bsconfig\.json$' \
  | grep -vE '\.config\.res$' \
  | grep -vE '^(rescript|servers|repos-monorepo|linguist|hyperpolymath-archive)/' \
  | grep -vE '/deps/' \
  | grep -vE '/node_modules/' \
  | grep -vE '/vscode/' \
  | grep -vE '/lib/(js|es6|bs)/' \
  | grep -vE '^(affinescript-deno-test|affinescript-cli)/' \
  | grep -vE '^2-protocols/avow/telegram-bot/avow-telegram-bot/' \
  || true)
if [ -n "$NEW_RS" ]; then
  echo "❌ New ReScript files detected (banned 2026-05-25). Use AffineScript instead."
  echo "$NEW_RS"
  echo ""
  echo "In-flight migration tracked under hyperpolymath/standards#252."
  echo "If this file belongs to a carve-out class, add it via"
  echo "the hypatia rule's path_allow_prefixes — see standards/.claude/CLAUDE.md"
  echo "§ReScript Exemptions (Approved)."
  exit 1
fi

# Block new package-lock.json (npm banned 2026-05-25; the JS runtime
# is Bun per the 2026-09-22 ruling, which banned Deno as well).
# Carve-outs (parallel to hypatia cicd_rules/nodejs_detected
# path_allow_prefixes — 8 classes):
#   **/vscode/   VSCode extension host-required toolchain (segment)
#   vscode-     VSCode-* extension repos / subdirs (substring)
#   tree-sitter- tree-sitter grammar npm-publish targets (Class C)
#   affinescript-deno-test/ + affinescript-cli/  bootstrap shims
#   rescript/ + servers/ + repos-monorepo/ + linguist/  upstream forks
#   hyperpolymath-archive/  archived repos
#   **/deps/ + **/node_modules/ + **/.lake/ + **/office-addin/
#     + **/bindings/{javascript,typescript}/  vendored / host-required /
#     consumer-facing exports
#   **/example/ + **/examples/ + **/test-fixtures/ + **/fixtures/
NEW_NPM_LOCK=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD~1 2>/dev/null \
  | grep -E '(^|/)package-lock\.json$' \
  | grep -vE '/vscode/' \
  | grep -vE 'vscode-' \
  | grep -vE 'tree-sitter-' \
  | grep -vE '^(affinescript-deno-test|affinescript-cli)/' \
  | grep -vE '^(rescript|servers|repos-monorepo|linguist|hyperpolymath-archive)/' \
  | grep -vE '/deps/' \
  | grep -vE '/node_modules/' \
  | grep -vE '/\.lake/' \
  | grep -vE '/office-addin/' \
  | grep -vE '/bindings/(javascript|typescript)/' \
  | grep -vE '/(example|examples|test-fixtures|fixtures)/' \
  || true)
if [ -n "$NEW_NPM_LOCK" ]; then
  echo "❌ New package-lock.json files detected (standards#67 — npm-avoidant). npm is tier 4: permitted, never preferred. Use Bun (tier 1); see 3-practice/LANGUAGE-POLICY.adoc §1."
  echo "$NEW_NPM_LOCK"
  echo ""
  echo "In-flight migration tracked under hyperpolymath/standards#253."
  echo "If this lockfile belongs to a carve-out class (vscode extension,"
  echo "bootstrap shim, example fixture, etc.), add it via the hypatia rule's"
  echo "path_allow_prefixes — see standards/.claude/CLAUDE.md §npm Exemptions."
  exit 1
fi

# Block new "Unnecessarily-JavaScript" .js / .jsx files (banned in NEW
# code as of 2026-05-25, where AffineScript bindings exist; replacement:
# AffineScript). Existing JS grandfathered while in-flight migration
# proceeds.
# Carve-outs (parallel to hypatia cicd_rules/javascript_detected +
# javascript_jsx_detected path_allow_prefixes — 8 classes):
#   mcp-bridge/ + **/plugins/  host-required (JS is the host contract)
#   *.config.js / *.config.cjs / *.config.mjs  tooling configs
#   affinescript-deno-test/ + affinescript-cli/  bootstrap shims
#   rescript/ + servers/ + repos-monorepo/ + linguist/  upstream forks
#   hyperpolymath-archive/  archived repos
#   **/deps/ + **/node_modules/  vendored package-manager deps
#   **/out/ + **/lib/js/ + **/.deno/  AS / RS compile output
#   **/vscode/ + **/extensions/vscode/  editor-host extension entry
NEW_JS=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A HEAD~1 2>/dev/null \
  | grep -E '\.jsx?$' \
  | grep -vE '^mcp-bridge/' \
  | grep -vE '/plugins/' \
  | grep -vE '\.config\.(js|cjs|mjs)$' \
  | grep -vE '^(affinescript-deno-test|affinescript-cli)/' \
  | grep -vE '^(rescript|servers|repos-monorepo|linguist|hyperpolymath-archive)/' \
  | grep -vE '/deps/' \
  | grep -vE '/node_modules/' \
  | grep -vE '/(out|lib/js|\.deno)/' \
  | grep -vE '/vscode/' \
  | grep -vE '/extensions/vscode/' \
  || true)
if [ -n "$NEW_JS" ]; then
  echo "❌ New 'Unnecessarily-JavaScript' files detected (banned 2026-05-25 in NEW code)."
  echo "Use AffineScript where bindings exist."
  echo "$NEW_JS"
  echo ""
  echo "In-flight migration tracked under hyperpolymath/standards#254."
  echo "If this file belongs to a carve-out class (MCP server, plugin host,"
  echo "tooling config, etc.), add it via the hypatia rule's"
  echo "path_allow_prefixes — see standards/.claude/CLAUDE.md §JavaScript Exemptions."
  echo "For an ad-hoc exemption use inline pragma:"
  echo "  // hypatia: allow cicd_rules/javascript_detected -- <reason>"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Language policy check passed"
